creativeThesis: Restore two people behind an assumed relationship, then reveal the tests that relationship created.
viewerExperience: An open escape becomes an identity strategy, its literacy and conversation vulnerabilities become understandable, then appearance fails the ownership test; discretionary passage and continuing danger complete the understanding.
emotionalTarget: Respect for deliberate self-emancipation and alert understanding of real risk, without voyeurism or comic costume treatment.
visualThesis: Later authentic portraits anchor Ellen and William; openly explanatory document and route graphics make appearance-versus-proof legible. Return to both named people after the imposed roles.

decisions.treatment: Authentic later engraved portraits, original explanatory register/hand diagrams, route sequence and restrained documentary typography.
decisions.rationale: Faces anchor two actual people; functional illustrations explain vulnerabilities while source labels distinguish testimony. No synthetic historical image.

ownerReview.rationale: Routine authorized treatment using cleared public-domain records, original graphics, established local narrator and licensed font; no significant unresolved departure. Next owner gate Master Review.
